title: Gunger reveals his perfect murder

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... murder anyone recently?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Awww, it's all just a bit of fun. Anyway, you remember Marv? My old friend who likes to chat about the perfect murder?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Awww, it's all just a bit of fun. Anyway, you remember Marv? My old friend who likes to chat about the perfect murder?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: What?! I'm kidding, I'm kidding! He's fine. Probably.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?! I'm kidding, I'm kidding! He's fine. Probably.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I gotta find ways to amuse myself. You hear about the Aseptic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I gotta find ways to amuse myself. You hear about the Aseptic?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Well whatever you hear on the news, I'm hearing different. There's another Aseptic. A real one. This one is just a copycat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well whatever you hear on the news, I'm hearing different. There's another Aseptic. A real one. This one is just a copycat.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I don't know. Yet. But I got my ear to the ground. Living on the streets, I'll know first. Before you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Yet. But I got my ear to the ground. Living on the streets, I'll know first. Before you.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: So listen, I was thinking about your murder method. I liked your thought process. But I got the real deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So listen, I was thinking about your murder method. I liked your thought process. But I got the real deal.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Exactly that. The murder that will not be solved, where I will not be caught and where the victim stands no chance of surviving.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly that. The murder that will not be solved, where I will not be caught and where the victim stands no chance of surviving.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Well, maybe it's better if I show you instead of just telling you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, maybe it's better if I show you instead of just telling you.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: You'll see. When you've made an enemy, you'll see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll see. When you've made an enemy, you'll see.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: What? No... No! But just be patient. When it happens, you'll understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? No... No! But just be patient. When it happens, you'll understand.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Patience! You'll get it. Just wait a bit. I have to go set something up. See ya!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Patience! You'll get it. Just wait a bit. I have to go set something up. See ya!
Yeah, he died.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I gotta find ways to amuse myself. You heard the Aseptic being dead?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I gotta find ways to amuse myself. You heard the Aseptic being dead?
That's not funny.
Are you being serious?
What?!
Why are you like this?
Whats with the dark humor?
Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So who is the real one?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So who is the real one?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So who is the real one?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So who is the real one?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The perfect murder?
Alright. I'm curious!
What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, are you going to murder someone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, are you going to murder someone?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait, are you going to murder someone?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait, are you going to murder someone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait...
I remember.
I was involved.
I kinda doubt that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure I even want to know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure I even want to know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure I even want to know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure I even want to know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not going to murder me, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not going to murder me, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're not going to murder me, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're not going to murder me, right?
